# pcg-cpp

Stripped down version of [PCG's C++ implementation](https://github.com/imneme/pcg-cpp)
from *M.E. O'Neill*.

Full details of the PCG family of random number generators
can be found at the [PCG-Random website](http://www.pcg-random.org/).

## Files extracted from upstream

- `include/pcg_extras.hpp`
- `include/pcg_random.hpp`
- `LICENSE-APACHE.txt`
- `LICENSE-MIT.txt`

## Changes from upstream

- Added `CMakeLists.txt` file.
- Removed 128-bit generators.
